ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, $C$ is the midpoint of $\overset{\frown}{ACB}$, $\angle AOC=4\angle B$, and $OC=4$. What is the degree measure of $\angle A$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} As shown in the figure, connect $AC, BC$\\
$\because \overset{\frown}{AB}=\overset{\frown}{AB}$,\\
$\therefore \angle AOB=2\angle ACB$,\\
$\because OA=OB$,\\
$\therefore \angle OAB=\angle OBA$,\\
$\therefore \angle AOB=180^\circ-2\angle B$,\\
$\because C$ is the midpoint of $\overset{\frown}{ACB}$,\\
$\therefore \overset{\frown}{AC}=\overset{\frown}{BC}$,\\
$\therefore \angle AOC=\angle BOC$,\\
$\because \angle AOC=4\angle B$,\\
$\therefore \angle AOC+\angle BOC+\angle AOB=360^\circ$,\\
that is, $4\angle B+4\angle B+180^\circ-2\angle B=360^\circ$,\\
$\therefore 6\angle B=180^\circ$,\\
$\therefore \angle A=\angle B=30^\circ$;\\
Thus, the measure of $\angle A$ is $\boxed{30^\circ}$.

method.method_draft: First read the diagram as a circle with center O, with radii OA, OB, and OC drawn to points A, B, C on the circle; A and B are the lower endpoints joined by chord AB, and C is the top point on the arc from A to B. From the text, use that C is the midpoint of arc ACB, so arcs AC and CB are equal, hence central angles ∠AOC and ∠COB are equal. Let ∠A = ∠B = x, justified either by equal arcs AC and CB giving equal chords AC and BC and thus isosceles triangle ABC, or by the symmetry forced by C being the midpoint of arc ACB. Since ∠AOC = 4∠B, both ∠AOC and ∠COB equal 4x, so the arc ACB has measure 8x. The remaining arc AB has measure 360° − 8x, so the inscribed angle ∠ACB subtending arc AB is half of that: 180° − 4x. Apply the triangle angle sum in triangle ABC: x + x + (180° − 4x) = 180°, giving x = 30°. Therefore ∠A = 30°.

推理：按坐标/对称方法，设 O=(0,0)，半径 OC=4，所以 C=(0,4)。因为 C 是弧 ACB 的中点，A、B 关于 OC 对称。令 t=∠AOC=∠COB，则可设 A=(-4 sin t, 4 cos t)，B=(4 sin t, 4 cos t)。由图中 A、B 在下方可知 t 为钝角，此时 AB 水平。点 B 处，BA 向左，BO 从 B 指向 O，因此 ∠B=t-90°。题设给出 ∠AOC=4∠B，即 t=4(t-90°)。解得 t=120°，所以 ∠B=30°。又 OA=OB，三角形 AOB 的底角相等，因此 ∠A=∠B=30°。

raw_record.original_question: As shown in the figure, $C$ is the midpoint of $\overset{\frown}{ACB}$, $\angle AOC = 4\angle B$, and $OC = 4$. What is the degree measure of $\angle A$?
raw_record.answer:
\textbf{Solution:} Connect $AC$ and $BC$. 
$\because \overset{\frown}{AB} = \overset{\frown}{AB}$, 
$\therefore \angle AOB = 2\angle ACB$, 
$\because OA = OB$, 
$\therefore \angle OAB = \angle OBA$, 
$\therefore \angle AOB = 180^\circ - 2\angle B$, 
$\because C$ is the midpoint of $\overset{\frown}{ACB}$, 
$\therefore \overset{\frown}{AC} = \overset{\frown}{BC}$, 
$\therefore \angle AOC = \angle BOC$, 
$\because \angle AOC = 4\angle B$, 
$\therefore \angle AOC + \angle BOC + \angle AOB = 360^\circ$, 
that is, $4\angle B + 4\angle B + 180^\circ - 2\angle B = 360^\circ$, 
$\therefore 6\angle B = 180^\circ$, 
$\therefore \angle A = \angle B = 30^\circ$. 
Thus, the measure of $\angle A$ is $\boxed{30^\circ}$.
raw_record.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there is a circle, O is inside the circle as the center of the circle, OA, OB, OC are respectively connected to A, B, C on the circle; A is at the lower left, B is at the lower right, C is above, there is chord AB between A and B, OC is connected upward to C. The problem gives that C is the midpoint of arc ACB, ∠AOC=4∠B, and OC=4. Reasoning: Because C is the midpoint of arc ACB, arc AC=arc CB, and the corresponding central angles ∠AOC=∠COB. Let the original base angles in the figure ∠A=∠OAB, ∠B=∠ABO be x. Since OA=OB are radii of the same circle, triangle AOB is an isosceles triangle, so ∠A=∠B=x. From ∠AOC=4∠B, ∠AOC=4x, therefore ∠COB=4x. The three central angles around the center of the circle satisfy ∠AOC+∠COB+∠BOA=360°, so ∠AOB=360°-8x. In triangle AOB, x+x+(360°-8x)=180°, simplifying gives 360°-6x=180°, so x=30°. Therefore ∠A=30°. OC=4 has no effect on solving for the angle.
